trialFields.trialId: opaque deterministic or local run key
trialFields.taskId: diagnostic, live-pointer, placement-set, first-organization, five-conversation-organization, or retrieval
trialFields.sourceNodeKeys: frozen synthetic fixture node keys only; empty for non-task diagnostics
trialFields.destinationGroupKeys: frozen synthetic fixture Group keys only; empty for non-task diagnostics
trialFields.queryKey: frozen synthetic query key or null
trialFields.stratum: warm, cold-relaunch, or named drop/placement stratum
trialFields.status: pass, fail, invalid, pending, or insufficient-evidence
trialFields.durationMilliseconds: monotonic ContinuousClock duration; omit when not timed
trialFields.eventSummary: coarse event names and monotonic offsets only
trialFields.coarseFailureReason: required for fail or invalid; no free-form personal content
